verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes recurring or cron-style scheduling of jobs or workflows. Managed Slurm's automatic workload scheduling (lambda-labs-docs-37) is queue and resource allocation, not time-based recurrence, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. Likewise, Kubernetes and Slurm environments and the Cloud API are building blocks a user could assemble into scheduling, not a documented recurring-job capability.
